d:
The Magic defeated the Celtics, 115-105 tonight in Boston. Desmond Bane contributed a team-high 24 points to go with 8 rebounds 5 assists and 3 three pointers, with Franz Wagner of the Magic adding an additional 21 points (8-21 FG) in the game. Jayson Tatum finished with a team-high 24 points along with 12 rebounds for the Celtics in the losing effort. The Magic improve their record to 6-7 with the win, while the Celtics fall to 11-3 for the season.
